items.title: Album Mandalasana Vol. 1
items.creator: KHP Kridhamardawa Karaton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat
items.description: KHP Kridhamardawa Karaton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat merilis dua album musik bertajuk Mandalasana : Album Mandalasana Vol. 1 - Ensembel Musik Gesek dan Album Mandalasana Vol. 2 - Ensembel Musik Tiup . Peluncuran ini digelar secara daring pada 4 Desember 2021 melalui kanal YouTube Kraton Jogja. Album-album ini menghadirkan ensambel orkestra dari Yogyakarta Royal Orchestra, memadukan semangat kebangsaan dengan musik barat yang dimainkan di Bangsal Mandhalasana, yang dibangun khusus untuk pertunjukan orkestra. Kedua album berisi lagu-lagu perjuangan dan kebangsaan Indonesia, seperti "Satu Nusa Satu Bangsa" dan "Bagimu Negeri," yang diharapkan dapat memupuk semangat kebangsaan di masa pandemi. KHP Kridhamardawa Karaton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat released two music albums titled Mandalasana : Album Mandalasana Vol. 1 - Ensembel Musik Gesek and Album Mandalasana Vol. 2 - Ensembel Musik Tiup . items.title: Major Parkinson
items.creator: Major Parkinson
items.description: Debut album of obscure Norwegian pervert rock band Major Parkinson, plus a bonus track of unclear providence and dubious quality. Read ever so marginally more at their Wikipedia page or their very own website, or buy something substantial in exchange for getting to so much as glance at the glory of a time when it was still cool to wear a suit while in an alt-rock band. (Don't mind the one or two tracks that aren't formatted quite right. For example "It's a Job" is actually track 7 out of 14. You'll have all the tools to fix it if you download it yourself. You can even hunt around for better versions of this album yourself.
